name: SPOT Stage-4 v2 attainable radial-solver tolerance sensitivity

amendment.reason: All three radial fixed-source solves exhausted MAXOUT=500 at h/2 in legacy binary32 arithmetic, so no valid G_h2(x0) exists.
amendment.scientific_claim_changed: The new experiment measures stability only over the attainable interval [h,2h]; it does not reclassify the failed h/2 attempt.

purpose: Evaluate exactly one coarse map G_2h(x0) and compare it with the strictly terminated, independently checked and replayed Stage-3 fine map G_h(x0).
Test whether radial-solver tolerance sensitivity is separated component by component from the coarse outer map defect without fitting, aggregation or relaxation.
Avoid a large Dragon REAL64 precision fork that would have to begin at FLU2DR and propagate through the full radial solver.

raw_same_point_observable.meaning: The existing RAW minus EVAL capture is a same-point primary-MOC defect at the plane-1 NATIVE and STATIONARY six-update arm terminals derived from the cap-500 restart; it is not a capture of all three original h/2 cap states and is not reused as a Stage-4 acceptance quantity.

tolerance_pair.selection_rule: The only new tolerance is the exact factor-two neighbor above the already frozen fine tolerance; no search over tolerances is allowed.

locked_inputs.same_x0_requirement: The coarse deck consumes the frozen basis_reference.xsm and state0_axial.xsm directly; it must not rebuild the POD basis or rerun the initializer.

locked_solver_controls.changed_control: Only the four map-solve tolerances change from h to 2h in the new coarse lane.

execution_budget.process_group_termination: SIGTERM followed by SIGKILL after a bounded grace period
execution_budget.fine_map_reuse_condition: The runtime executable and every locked fine-map and seed artifact must match the declared hashes exactly; otherwise the archival fine lane cannot be reused and this protocol authorizes no run.
execution_budget.future_production_preflight: A future runner must require the non-public local artifact checks and explicit frozen-executable verification; the public-only protocol check can never authorize execution.

required_implementation_properties: The coarse deck starts from the frozen x0 and fixed POD basis without an initializer solve.
The coarse deck performs exactly three online radial fixed-source solves and one returned axial solve.
The coarse deck contains no outer SPOD iteration loop.
The same fission source identity, leakage feedback, rank, geometry, materials, tracks and solver controls are used in both lanes.
The only scientific input difference between lanes is the exact factor-two map tolerance.
No failed h/2 output state enters the coarse deck, checker or classification.
A timeout or abnormal process exit publishes no scientific result.
A first valid capture writes one canonical five-file scientific manifest and remains PENDING-REPLAY; that manifest and its receipt must be committed before replay.
Replay is one separate explicit invocation and must reproduce the committed capture manifest byte for byte.

raw_log_checker.implementation: Independent parser of the unmodified Dragon log
required: exactly three radial and one returned axial coarse solve
strict STATE=1 terminal record for all four solves
declared 2h tolerance bits and unchanged MAXOUT/MAXINR controls
normal process completion before the wall-clock limit

xsm_checker.implementation: Ganlib-only read-only checker independent of the SPOT solver
required: frozen executable and all input hashes
bitwise-identical x0 canonical state and fixed POD trial space
for each plane, bitwise-identical pre-solve SYSTEM/SPOT-LEAK1D equal to x0 leakage L0
for each plane, bitwise-identical radial FLUX/SPOT-QFISS and FLUX/SPOT-FS-K map inputs
the post-SPOLEAK FLUX/SPOT-LEAK1D value is L1 and must never be substituted for the pre-solve SYSTEM/SPOT-LEAK1D input
fixed-source identity and finite radial balance diagnostics
axial Galerkin residual and finite global and group balance diagnostics
independent recomputation of D_out_2h, D_out_h and D_in
all reported D components are finite and nonnegative
fresh isolated coarse replay with byte-identical five scientific outputs

component_rule.zero_coarse_outer: RESOLVED iff D_in == 0 at stored precision

classification.stage5_authorization: Only QUALIFIED-ON-2H-TO-H-SCALE authorizes a separately frozen short direct-Picard trajectory at fine tolerance h.

forbidden_changes: Do not increase MAXOUT or MAXINR.
Do not change the component rule after observing the coarse result.
Do not try another coarse tolerance if 2h is invalid or unresolved.
Do not add relaxation, damping, fitted coefficients, clipping or flux floors.
Do not call the result an h/2 qualification, convergence order, solver-error bound or REAL64 equivalence.
Do not run a long SPOD trajectory under this protocol.
interpretation_limits: A qualified result demonstrates stability only over the tested attainable binary32 interval [h,2h].
It does not prove asymptotic tolerance convergence or bound the exact radial-solver error.
It does not erase or reclassify the failed h-to-h/2 experiment.
The existing raw same-point defect remains diagnostic and is not an acceptance threshold.
The experiment validates one coarse map comparison, not outer SPOD convergence.

next_decision.QUALIFIED-ON-2H-TO-H-SCALE: Freeze a short direct Picard trajectory using fine tolerance h and the unmodified raw map.
next_decision.UNRESOLVED: Do not run Picard; the legacy binary32 radial solver does not separate inner sensitivity from the coarse outer defect on the tested interval.
next_decision.INVALID: Stop without another tolerance trial; investigate an independently designed radial solver only if stricter inner qualification is required.
